verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents a first-party HRIS integration for onboarding new employees and removing departed ones (jumpcloud-docs-24, jumpcloud-docs-11). It can import users from an HR system as the authoritative source (jumpcloud-docs-13) and claims automated identity creation, access changes and termination across the lifecycle (jumpcloud-docs-20, jumpcloud-docs-4). The vendor hedges this as "minimal manual intervention" rather than fully hands-off. missing for 10: explicit HRIS-driven mover (attribute/role change) handling, documented propagation of HRIS changes into app assignments/SCIM downstream, list of supported HRIS connectors, independent or hands-on corroboration.
